steps.en: Officer selects notices from the results
steps.id: Officer memilih notice dari hasil pencarian
steps.why_en: Selection exists in the list but it is only wired to other batch actions, not to reduction.
steps.why_id: Pilihan notice ada di daftar tetapi hanya tersambung ke aksi batch lain, bukan reduction.

steps.en: Officer picks the Fine Reduction action
steps.why_en: No Fine Reduction action exists in the staff portal; its page and routes are commented out.
steps.why_id: Aksi Fine Reduction tidak ada di portal staff; halaman dan route-nya dikomentari.

steps.en: Reduction is applied to all selected notices
steps.id: Reduction diterapkan ke semua notice terpilih
steps.why_en: The system only reduces one notice per request; nothing handles a whole selection in one go.
steps.why_id: Sistem hanya mengurangi satu notice per permintaan; tidak ada yang menangani seluruh pilihan sekaligus.

steps.en: The reduction is saved on each reduced notice
steps.id: Reduction tersimpan di setiap notice yang dikurangi
